build_semantic_segmentor: build a SemanticSegmentor model from a detectron2 config with backbone and sem_seg_head
build_sem_seg_head: build a semantic segmentation head using build_sem_seg_head from config and input shape
create_sem_seg_fpn_head: create a SemSegFPNHead that takes FPN features and predicts per-pixel semantic segmentation
run_semantic_segmentor_forward: run the SemanticSegmentor forward pass on batched inputs to get per-pixel segmentation logits
review_sem_seg_heads_registry: review the SEM_SEG_HEADS_REGISTRY to list registered semantic segmentation head classes
